★ Request
Fade to black
It seems I had lost sight of something truly important.
No, please don't mind me—

Even if I ask to go somewhere eccentric, or ask to do so many things...
you'll always accept it all, won't you...?

Ehehe... These are Dia's honest feelings right now!
That's all right, isn't it, Trainer?
Ah! U-Um...
(I see... That's how you really felt about it...)
Um, do I scoop them up with this bowl?
Yes... very much so...!

Um, even if I speak my mind honestly...
Trainer... it won't... trouble you...?

The annual summer training camp began once again.
Satono Diamond tackled the grueling regimen with all her might.

I tend to blurt out and do whatever comes to mind, don't I?
I started worrying that I was just being a burden to you...

Yes, absolutely! It's a promise.
I'll think of all the places I want to go!

You'd better prepare yourself, okay? Since you said
'honesty is a strength'... I won't hold back anymore!
...! Are you sure that's all right?
A strength...?

—Ehh~!? There's a festival tonight?
I wanna go, I wanna go! Let's all go together~!

Ah, no.
Trainer, which one do you think would be better?

A poi...?
Ah, so the rule is to scoop them up with that round tool!

Without tearing such thin paper...
I wonder what that feels like? Mmm...?

Phew! My time improved again.
I'm not feeling very tired yet, so perhaps my stamina has increased?

That's why I felt I had to suppress myself and hold back.
Because the other day...
...I thought as much.
Yes!
A festival...? That sounds lovely, so much fun!

Happy...? It makes you happy when I rely on you?
I'm not... a burden...?
—Is it really all right for me to just be honest...!
Right, since it's hot today, let's swi—

In that case, I want to add more stamina training.
I should discuss the next regimen with her.

Um...
...Trainer, you seem awfully motivated, don't you?

It seemed she had been holding herself back over some worry...
However, there was no need for that. Because—
(That's right... Even back then, Trainer always—)

Just as I thought... Satono Diamond has seemed somewhat
awkward ever since that day at the amusement park...

But when I thought that you might not actually want it,
I couldn't bring myself to say anything.

Ufufu! 
You're as dependable as ever... Ah—!
Yes.

So, no.
I just want to stay here with you a little longer, Trainer.

Catching up at a light trot,
Satono Diamond gently tugged at my sleeve from behind.
Ah, Trainer—
"To be honest... I don't think you'd stand a chance as you are now."

Ah, what is that? It's not goldfish scooping...
There are so many sparkling things floating around.
...Trainer! Um, I... I—!
I want to keep watching them just like this, just the two of us!
No... please.

Waaah...!
Amazing! I caught a big one!

Step right up, step right up!
All-you-can-scoop sparkly balls right here~!

Yes. The truth is, I was so happy about those prizes, and for a moment
I almost said, 'Let's have matching ones,' and 'I'll win one too'...

Letting her lead me by the hand, we sat side by side on the sandy beach.
And there, we watched the distant fireworks bloom in the night sky—
Fufu... I really should have just been honest with you.

(Even when I come straight at you, you always respond in kind...
And thanks to that, we are where we are today.)

Fireworks continued to light up the distant sky.
If we headed back toward the festival grounds, we could probably get a closer view.

Please answer me honestly.
What will happen if things stay as they are?

Once we stepped away from the bustle and were left alone, Satono Diamond
began opening up to me, bit by bit...

—Wah! It's so lively here.
There are so many fascinating food stalls!
